Root cause was in `strip_reminders` (`anthrouter/request_text.py`). Its docstring promises to "trim outer whitespace", but it never did. After the `<system-reminder>` block was removed, the newline after it stayed at the start of the text. That made `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` fail.

I added `.strip()` to the return value, so every caller of `strip_reminders` now gets trimmed text, not just `is_activity_label_prompt`.

I ran your example through `is_activity_label_prompt` and it now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite: `make test` needs `python`, which isn't on the PATH, and `python3` has no pytest installed.
